comment: Profile-and-read cases. The AMD skills catalog does not grade this file. Run it here with ./skills/run_evals.py --extended.

evaluations.prompt:
profile my HIP application with rocprof-compute and tell me where the time goes

The application is ./vcopy.cpp.
expected_behavior: asks for the launch command and a workload name before profiling
runs analyze with --list-stats to find the hottest kernel
unexpected_behavior: invents a profiling flag instead of checking --help

evaluations.prompt:
which kernel is the hotspot in ./workloads/my_app and why is it slow?

The application is ./vmem.hip.
expected_behavior: points --path at the directory containing profiling_config.yaml rather than a parent directory
uses --list-stats first, then narrows to one kernel id with -k
reads the System Speed-of-Light panel before opening a detailed block

evaluations.prompt:
a full rocprof-compute replay of this workload is too expensive, collect something cheaper

The application is ./vmem.hip.
expected_behavior: offers a single-pass option such as --set, a narrowed -b, or --iteration-multiplexing
warns which analysis panels will be empty afterwards

evaluations.prompt:
profile only the kernels whose names end in bound in my ROCm application

The application is ./occupancy.hip.
expected_behavior: uses rocprof-compute profile -k to filter by kernel name
treats the profile-time -k value as a regex matched against kernel names
